author: mark
text:
Phase 2: v0.3 conv-repo template + scaffold

Replace the embedded v0.2 .agent/-rooted template with the v0.3 shape
pinned by ARCH §2.2: manifest.yaml, workflow.yaml, providers.yaml,
version, souls/ at the conv-repo root (outside any worktree); root/ as
the primary worktree with .git inside it and .gitattributes pinning
goal.md/soul.md/summary/** to merge=ours per ARCH §2.6.

scaffold() creates dest/, extracts the embedded template, makes
dest/root/, writes .gitattributes, and runs git init + add + commit
inside root/. Control-plane files are deliberately untracked.

lernie new accepts an optional path: with no arg, scaffolds at
<harness-root>/conversations/<auto-id>/ and prints the path on stdout.

Manifest type updated to ARCH §5.2 role-keyed shape; OverflowPolicy
variants become drop_oldest_steps + truncate (+ summarize/drop). New
Action::SpawnRootConversation variant for the v0.3 workflow.yaml.

The v0.2 prompt path still expects .agent/ and is unchanged; Phase 3
(bl-7bca) re-wires it. tests/prompt_end_to_end.rs is #[ignore]d for
the duration with a pointer to the unblocking ball.
